title: 陆克文：欧盟中国汽车协议只是小步，欧洲制造业压力才是核心？
speaker: Kevin Rudd

segments.en: Another that happened is of course this recent EU and China deal when it comes to hybrid cars and really putting a cap there when it comes to the exports of some of these Chinese hybrid cars. Do you think it does anything in terms of the bilateral balance between the two?
segments.zh: 另一件事当然是最近欧盟和中国关于混合动力汽车的协议，实际上对部分中国混合动力汽车的出口设定了上限。你认为这对双边平衡有什么作用吗？

segments.en: Look I'm sure all the trade diplomats were patting themselves on the back as a result of this both in Beijing and from Brussels but the bottom line is what this is do about the existential threat to German manufacturing across the board not just in hybrids in EVs across auto writ large and across Europe in terms of manufacturing writ large.
segments.zh: 我相信北京和布鲁塞尔的贸易外交官们都为此沾沾自喜，但底线是，这对德国制造业面临的生存威胁有什么作用？不仅是混合动力车，还有电动车，乃至整个汽车行业，以及整个欧洲制造业。

segments.en: I'm not sure our Chinese friends have fully got the memo that this is now the number one issue in chances across Europe because the future viability of European manufacturing is at stake.
segments.zh: 我不确定我们的中国朋友是否完全明白，这现在是整个欧洲的头号问题，因为欧洲制造业的未来生存能力岌岌可危。

segments.en: So the 16 point agreement everyone will be feeling chipper about that that's great but the bottom line is this is but one small step towards what is needed and I'm not sure if we'll be delivered by the Chinese side in time.
segments.zh: 所以16点协议，大家都会为此感到高兴，这很好，但底线是，这只是朝着所需方向迈出的一小步，我不确定中方是否会及时兑现。

segments.en: The underpinning reason for that as you know as someone who analyzes the Chinese economy is that the Chinese growth model is now chronically dependent on net exports because the domestic growth drivers are performing so poorly. So this actually is the one thing which is keeping China's growth positive.
segments.zh: 正如你作为分析中国经济的人所知，根本原因在于，中国的增长模式现在长期依赖净出口，因为国内增长动力表现疲弱。所以这实际上是保持中国增长为正的一件事。

segments.en: So therefore you have this intersection point between European deindustrialisation on the one hand and then China's chronic export dependency on the other.
segments.zh: 因此，你就有了欧洲去工业化与中国长期出口依赖之间的交汇点。
